    Modules over the primitive quotient #

    This file identifies finitely generated right modules over the manuscript's literal primitive quotient A/AeA with the full subcategory of ambient right A-modules annihilated by AeA. The auxiliary quotient of Aᵐᵒᵖ is used only to apply Mathlib's quotient-module API; an explicit algebra equivalence returns every public categorical statement to (A/AeA)ᵐᵒᵖ.
